{{Top|leg}}
A '''thermal collector''' was a device capable of channelling geothermal energy from a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] core to power an installation. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Mortex Sector HQ]] on [[Fangol]] used thermal collectors to power the base.
